ge rkyang pa la srog med ces zer srol med de/ ma gzhi nas dbyangs kyi drang por thad mar 'gros ldan gyi a gnas pa'i srol mchis te/ gang zhig steng 'og tu gug gu dang zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ na ro bzhi bo ldan na srog la ba sa kyang /gtso bo ni legs sbyar la mi ldan pa'i tsheg ces pa'i ri mo til 'bru tsam 'di yin zhing / bod yig tu tsheg 'dis ma bcad na/ tsheg khyim mi 'grub cing / tsheg med na sdo da rjes tshams 'dres par 'gyur bas brjod bya ston pa'i bya ba byed mi nus pas rdo leb 'og gi 'bu grog ma'i tshang ltar rtsir/ legs sbyar gyi gsal byed phan tshun sbyar ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis grangs ston mi 'dra bas/ bod la 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje lta bu yig 'bru sum cu gnas/ de'ang bod yig la kub tu med kyang / rjes 'jug dang 'phul can dang mgo can dang / 'dogs can sogs rnams kyi rnam gzhag mdzad pas/ mtha' gcig tu srog can srog med kyi dbye ba de'ang bde ba ma yin pa 'jug par dka' ba dang / dgos pa lhag par mi che bas de ltar ma mdzad pa'o// bod yig ni 'dzam gling yig rigs kyi bang mdzod nang du mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan la/ khyad du 'phags shing mtshar sdug mnga' ba'i yi ge zhig yin pas sus kyang khas len gyin yod pa red/ces saṃ bod kyi yi ge'i skor bshad pa'i sa bcad gsum pa rdzogs so/ //75
sa bcad bzhi ba/ saṃ bod rnam dbye'i skor bshad pa/rnam dbye zhes pa ni chos gang rung ba zhig gi ming tshig peṃ ga'atsha dang ma 'dres par rngam pa so sor dbye 'ing dbyed nus pa'i sgra'i cha shas su gyur pa'i tshig phrad cig la rnam dbye zhes tshe tan zhabs drung rin po ches gsungs shing /yang na brjod bya'i don so sor rnam par 'byed pa'i don du ston pa yin no/ /de'ang rgya bod rnam dbye'i rnam grangs dang 'brel ba dang / khyad par/ bsgyur chos bcas rim bzhin bshad na/ thog mar rgya bod rnam dbye'i rnam grangs bshad par bya'o/ /dang po/ legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye'i rnam grangs bshad pa/lesas sbyar gyi skad la rnam dbye zhes pa ni/ mdo las/ rnam dbye mtha' can ni tshig go /rnam dbye med pa ni ming ngo zhes si sogs dang ti sonas rnam dbye'i mtha' can de la tshig ces brjod pa dang / byings bor ba rnam dbye dang mi ldan pa kritra dang / de phan dang / tshig bsdu sogs kyi mtha' can don dang 176
——ldan pa de la ming ngam rtags zhes bya ste/ ming gi mthar sbya ra bas tshig tu grub pa byed pa'i rkyen si sogs bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa dang / spyi dang khyad par dus kyi go bar spyad pa'i dom la ti so gas la byings kyi rnam dbye brgya dang brgyad cu yod de/ skabs 'dir rtags kyi si sogs sbyar nas rnam 'gyur byas pa'i ming gi rnam dbye ngos 'dzin te dbye ba bstan pa ni/ de las pha rol rnam dbye'o/ /zhes ming las pha rol tu si la sogs pa'i rnam dbye bdun po rnams 'gyur te/ si yodza4 dang po dang / amra chashas gnyis pa dang / ṭā 6za gyis gsum pa dang / nge 64 nyis bzhi ba dang / ngasi bh+yapra )sra lnga ba dang /rasra osu āt+pa drug pa dang / ji os supra bdun pa zhes pa ste/ de'ang dang po'i gsum tshan gyis don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa dang / gnyis pa'i gsum tshan gyis las su bya ba ston pa/ gsum pa'i gsum tshan gyis byed pa ston pa/ bzhi ba'i gsum tshan gyis dgos ched ston pa/ lnga ba'i gsum tshan gyis 'byung khungs ston pa/ drug pa'i gsum tshan gyis 'brel ba ston pa/ bdun pa'i gsum tshan gyis gnas pa ston pa'o/ /rnam dbye bdun po de dag gsum tshan du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rtags la sde tshan re re bzhin 'dra bas/ rim pa bzhin gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mang tshig ces gsum du dbye ba'i phyir ro// de dag gis bsgyur bas nyi shu rtsa gcig grangs nges pa yin na/ brgyad pa bod pa zhes 'ga' zhig tu gsungs pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ ka lā pa ra bod pa'ang ngo zhes dang tsan+d+ra par yang bod la'o zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rtags kyi don tsam la dang po'i sde tshan ster bar ma zad/ bod pa'i don la'ang don tshan dang po nyid sbyin /77
—pa zhes pa'i kon yin sgyu/ rnam dbye sde tshan bdun las lhag pa'i brgyad yod pa ston pa'i lugs ma yin zhing / ma rdo de dag gis ni bod pa'i sgra rnam dbye dang po 'i 'ongs su ridu parnga bstan pa yin no //skabs 'dir ming gi rnam dbye nyer gcig las/ sko dzaro ‘/ khiñca / chushas/ ṭā/ nge/ ngasi/ ngas/ yosra/ aza/ ji/ yosra bcas bcu gsum la dbyangs dang po can gyi rnam dbye dang / si/ 6po/ )sra/ bh+yapra/ 6sra/lcam/ 6sra/ suspru bcas brgyad la sa yig dang bha yig dang po can nam ha sa dang po can gyi rnam dbye dang / si/ ma dza4/ amra/ chabacas la rnam dbye thog ma lnga'am si sogs lnga dang / nge sogs nga yig dang ldan pa'i rnam dbyer nga 'gro ba'i rnam dbye zhes bya'o//de dag nye bar mtshon na/ de'i rnam dbye rnams dang de'i cho ga rnams bshad par bya ste/ spyir btang skyes bu rtags a thung mtha' can de la yang ming gi rnam dbye rnams 'gyur te/1 rnam dbye dang po don tsam brjod pa/de'i gcig tshig la/ rta'i skad dod asha zhes pa'i rtags bzhag rnam dbye dang po gcig tshig gi si byin/ si'i i brjod pa'i don gyis phyis/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do zhes sra rnam bcad byas pas ashāḥ(rta)zhes grub/de nas rnam dbye dang po'i nyis tshig la/ gong ltar rta'i skad dod ashwa zhis pa'i rtags bzhag de la rnam dbye dang po'i nyis tshig 'jibyin/ ka lā pa zhes mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ sbra srog med du gyur/ o skyogal 665 zhes a au 178
'dus pas yoru gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro zhes mdos lnga srog med yothog tu drangs pas asho(rta dag)zhes grub/de nas rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig la yang ashwa zhes pa'i rtags bzhagde la rnam dbye dang po'i mang tshig gi dza4 byin/ dza yig ni it+ya'i ming can te dbyi/ dbyangs a bzhag ka lā pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ lnga srog med du gyur/ 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa ring po'o zhes a a 'dus pas ltaring gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos smra srog med lhathog tu drangs/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do zhes sra rnam bcad 'gyur bas khu(rta rnams)zhes grub/skabs la lar dzas pha rol las a yig mtha' can la a sugra ltag ma zhes rkyen glo bur bster pas u brjod don/ gra rjes 'brel gyis dgyi/ 'dra ring /drangs pas ashāsaḥ(rta rnams)zhes rnam dbye dang po'i gsum tshan grub bo/2 rnam dbye gnyis pa las sam bya ba brjod pa/rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig la/ yang ashwa zhes pa'i rtags bzhaggnyis pa'i gcig tshig gi aza gyi a dbyi bar bya/ mra ni rjes su nga ro byas te/asha(rta la)zhes grub/de nas gnyis pa'i gnyis tshig gi 6byin/ ka lā pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ spru srog med du gyur/ o yol gu'o zhes a dang 'ji'adus pas charu gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos sbra srog med mthog tu drangs pas asho(rta dag la)zhes grub/de nas gnyis pa'i mang tshig gi sha4 byin/ shra yin ni shas la'o zhes pa'i /79
khyad don yin pas dbyi/ as bzhag skyes pa la sra'i na'o zhes sra yig nu yig tu 'gyur/ sha4 la'o/ /zhes shas pha rol snga ma'i ring por 'gyur/ amra shaza dag gi a'o zhes pas a dbyi/ a shān(rta rnams la)zhes rnam dbye gnyis pa'i sum tshan grub bo/ /3 rnam dbye gsum pa cad yo brjod pa/thog mar gsum pa'i gcig tshig la/ gong ltar rta'i skad dod ashwa zhes pa'i rtags bzhag de la gsum pa'i gcig tshig gi ṭā byin/ zla i na'o zhes ṭā yig i na ru bsgyur/ ka lā pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ smra srog med du gyur/ a i la e'o zhes a i 'dus pas e ru gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs smra srog med e thog tu drangs pas gshen(rta yis yang na rtas)zhes grub/de nas gsum pa'i gnyis tshig gi rgyas byin/ bha la āt+pa'o zhes rnam dbye bha yig pha rol la rtags mtha'i a yig ni lharu 'gyur/ ma ni rjes su nga ro'i zhes za yig nga ro la 'gyur te/ ashā:(rta dag gis)zhes grub/de nas gsum pa'i mang tshig gi 9su sbyin/ ti'i bha'i a'o zhes rtags mtha'i a yig mtha' las pha rol gyi gyisra'i bha yig ni a ru 'gyur/ ka la pā sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ spru srog med du gyur/ a i la e'o zhes a i 'dus pas e ru gyur/ de yang a e la yi'o zhes ye ni ke sha can i yig tu 'gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos phra srog med i thog tu drangs/sra dra dag gi rnam bcad da zhes sa yig rnam bcad du gyur pas/ mashī ཿ(rta 180
rnams kyis)zhes rnam dbye gsum pa'i sum tshan grub po/ /4 rnam dgye bzhi ba ngagos ched brjod pa/de'i gcig tshig la/ yang rta'i skad dod ashwa zhes pa'i rtags bzhagbzhi ba'i gcig tshig gi nge byin/ dra yig ni 'gro ba'i don te dbyi/ a bzhagnge'i akra'o zhes akra ā ga ma byin/ kra rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ nge'i e ayu'o zhes e ayu ru gyur/ ka lā pa rim pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/phra srog med du gyur/ 'dra ba'i yi che 'dus pa ring po'o zhes a dang a 'dus pas lharing por gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos khra srog med a+thi+-i thog tu drangs/ yā srog med a thog tu drangs pas a shāya(rta yi ched du)nges grub/de nas bzhi pa'i gnyis tshig gi snyam byin/ de la ashwa rtags dang byam zhes gnas pa la/ bha la āta'o zhes rtags mtha' ring por gyur/ ma ni rjes su nga ro zhes ma yig nga rngo ru bsgyur/ drangs pas ar+sā6(rta rnams kyi ched du)zhes grub/de nas bzhi ba'i mang tshig gi 6sra byin/ asha rtags dang lhas zhes gnas pa la/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /mang tshig sa yig dang bha yig pha rol rtags mtha'i a yig e nyid du 'gyur/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad ces sra yig rnam bcad byas pas yo96ཿ(rta rnams kyi ched du)zhes rnam dbye bzhi ba'i sum tshan grub bo/5 rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs ba'od pa/
yang lnga ba'i gcig tshig la/ sngar bzhin rta'i skad dod a sha rtags bzhagde la lnga ba'i gcig tshig gi ngasi byin/ ashwa rtags dang ngasi zhes gnas pa la/ngasi'i āt+pa'o zhes rtags mtha' a yig las pha rol gyi ngasi'i āt+pa du 'gyur/ka lā pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/ smra srog med du gyur/ 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring po'o zhes a dang lta'adus par ā ring por gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos smra srog med ā thog tu drangs pas ashātan(rta las)zhes grub/de nas lnga pa'i gnyis tshig gi byam byin/ ashwa rtags dang / 6za zhes gnas pa la/ bha la sogs kyis rtags mtha' ring po'o zhes rtags mtha' ring por gyur/ ma ni rjes su nga ro zhes za yig nga ro byas/ drangs pas ashā:(rta dag las)zhes grub/ de nas lnga pa'i mang tshig gi cas byin/ ashwa rtags dang / 6sra zhes gnas pa la/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o/ /zhes rtags mtha'i a yig e ru gyur/sngar bzhin sa ra dag gi rnam bcad do zhes sra yig rnam bcad byas pas atswa6ཿ(rta rnams las)zhes rnam dbye lnga ba'i sum tshan grub bo/ /6 rnam dbye drug pa 'thel ba can brjod pa/drug pa'i gcig tshig gi ngasra byin/ ashwa rtags dang / ngasra zhes gnas pa la/ ngasra su'o zhes rtags mtha'i a yig las pha rol gyi ngasra su ru 'gyur bas ashasu(rta yi)zhes grub pa dang /de nas drug pa'i nyis tshig gi osu byin/ ashwa rtags dang / os zhes 182
gnas pa la/ yosra la'o/ /zhes os pha rol rtags mtha'i a yig ni e ru 'gyur/smra srog med du gyur/ e a pa'o zhes e yig ayu ru bsgyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos lnga srog med a thog tu drangs/ lnga srog med o thog tu drangs/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad do zhes sa rnam bcad du gyur pas ashwakroḥ(rta dag gi)zhes grub pa dang /de nas drug pa'i mang tshig gi os byin/ ashwa rtags dang / āt+pa zhes gnas pa la/ lhama'i nuṭa'o zhes nus ā ga ma byin/ ṭu rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ u brjod don yin pas dbyi/ nu srog med du gyur/ nā ma la'o zhes na ma pha rol la rtags mtha' ring por gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos nu srog med ā thog tu drangs/ lnga ni rjes su nga ro'o zhes rjes su nga ro gyur pas aṅgāmā(rta rnams kyi)zhes rnam dbye drug pa'i sum tshan grub bo/ /7 rnam dbye bdun pa gnas sam gzhi brjod pa/ bdun pa'i gcig tshig gi ji byin/ ashwa rtags dang / ji zhes gnas pa la/ dra khyad don yin pas dbyi nas a ba'ag ka lā pa rim pa sogs mdos wa'i srog gi a phral/smra srog med du gyur/ a i la e'o zhes a i 'dus pasra e ru gyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa sogs mdos lnga srog med e thog tu drangs pas gshe(rta la )zhes grub pa dang /de nas bdun pa'i gnyis tshig gi osu byin/ de'ang ashwa zhes pa'i rtags bzhag yosra zhes pa'i rnam dbye ster/ osu la'o zhes rtags mtha'i a e ru gyur/smra srog med du gyur/ e ayu'o zhes ayu ru bsgyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa 183
sogs mdos smra srog med a thog tu drangs/ lnga srog med rma thog tu drangs/ sra rnam bcad du gyur pas ashayoḥ(rta dag 'a )zhes grub pa dang /de nas bdun pa'i mang tshig gi supra byin/ ashwa rtags dang / supra zhes gnas pa la/ blo rjes 'brel dbyi/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o zhes rtags mtha'i a e ru gyur/ ku i la las byas pa 'i sa'i khu'o zhes rnam dbye sa yig ga yig tu 'gyur bas yoshekhu(rta rnams 'a )zhes rnam dbye bdun pa'i sum tshan grub bo/ /8 zad pa'i don du rnam dbye gsum/ashwa la dang po gcig tshig si zhes gnas pa la/ kun tu 'bod pa la si rnyi'o zhis si la rnyi zhes zer bas/ byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pal rnyi dbyi'o zhes ṣ+ha dbyi bar bya ste rnyi phyis/ kun tu bod pa'i rnam dbye byin pa'i don du he sngon du bzhag ste/ r+ha ashāḥ(kye rta)zhes pa dang / gnyis pa gnyis tshig 9byin pa la sngar bzhin sgrub pas he asho(kye rta dag)ces dang / gsum pa mang tshig la dza4 byin pas sngar sgrub pa bzhin grub pas he ashāḥ(kye rta rnams)zhes bod pa'i sum tshan grub bo/ /'di ni skyes bu a thung mtha' can la sbyar ba kho na yin pas/ gzhan yang rnam dbye bdun po la dbyangs mtha' skyes pa'i mtha' can la skyes pa'i rtags uring mtha' can dang / i thung mtha' can/ u thung mtha' can/ ī ring mtha' can/ u ring mtha' can/ ṛ yig mtha' can/ i yig mtha' can/cugayig mtha' can/ snyogayig mtha' can sogs dang /dbyangs mtha' las bud med kyi rtags la/ bud med kyi rtags a thung 184
mtha' can dang / lharing mtha' can dang / i yig mtha' can dang / u yis mtha' can/ lhoṇ+ḍa mtha' can dang / ṛ yig mtha' can bcas so/ /dbyangs mtha' las ma ning si rtags la/ ma ning sga rtags a thung mtha' can/ i yig mtha' can/ u yis mtha' can/ ṛ yig mtha' can/ā ring mtha' can/ ī yig mtha' can/ lū yig mtha' can/ i yis mtha' can bcas so/ /ha sa'i mtha' can skyes pa'i rtags la / hu yig mtha' can dang dra yignu yis ma yig nga yig/ dz+ra yis du yig dz+dza yis bra yig tsu yigtro yig shu yig khuyib sra yis bcas so 1 /ha sa'i mtha' can bud med kyi rtabs : hu yigamatha' can/ rim bzhin bra yis dra yis nga yig rdza yig du yig za yig tsu yig pra yig shu yig snga yig sra yig bcas so/ /ha sa'i mtha' can ma ning si rtags la/ dra yis nu yig du yig ma yig tsu yig tro yig sa yig khu yig bcas tshang ma ming gi mtha' can la rnam dbye rgasum re 'jug tshul ba'ad pa yin/de'ang yu3dra asmad kyi rnam 'gyur dang / tshig sdud sogs rgyas par sgra bzhung chen mo dag la yod kyang / gnas skabs su rnam dbye nyer gcig 'di thob mar ngos zin pa'i ched du brjod pa yin rna// 85
gnyis pa/ bod kyi rnam dbye'i rnam grangs bshad pa/de nas thon mis brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung chen po brgyad mdzad yod pa 'i yam la sa nar tra nying 4 sdu shu h+nā cu 6 lta sa sto naca/ dbye brgyad du dbye bas de dag gi khungs ni gtso bo bod rang gi kha skad la brten nas bzos sheng bsgrigs pa zhig yin te/ dper na/ kye dpal ldan/ khyod kyis nyos pa'i gos chen de hrang he nas bzos pa'i gos chen yin pas tshong khang gang gi nang na gda'/ nga mgyogs por nyo ru 'gro dgos pas nga la bshad rogs gyis/ zhes skad cha 'di lta bu thung thung zhig la rnam dbye tshang ma yod pas de bzhin no/ /'di dag so sor bkral nas brjod na/ kye dpal ldan zhes 'bod tshig gsal ba'i sgra sbyar bas chos gang zhig gi ngo bo de dag 'bod pa la rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa'i sgra dang / de nas dpal ldan zhes brjod pa'i ming tsam gyi sgra'i nus pas chos ji snyed pa las dpal ldan nyid ngo bo rnam pa ston thub pas na rnam dbye dang po don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa/ khyod kyis nyos zhes i ldan gyi phrad kyi rjes su rjes 'jug bcu ba sa yig sbyar ba'i rkyen gyi nus pas byed pa po khyod kyis bya ba nyos pa sogs ma 'dres par so sor dbye ba ston pa ni rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra dang /nyos pa'i gos chen zhes i ldan gyi 'i sgra rkyen du ster ba'i nus pas 'brel gzhi dang 'brel chos bar gyi chos ma 'dres par so sor ston pa rnam dbye drug/ pa'i /86
'brel sgra dang / hrang he nas bzos/ zhes nas rkyen du ster ba'i nus pas bzo sa'i 'byung khungs dang gzhi hrang he nas chos gos chen de bral ba'i don ma 'dres par ston pa rnam dbye lnga ba'i 'byung khungs dang / tshong khang nang na gda' zhes pa'i la don gyi na sgra rkyen du ster ba'i nus pas gnas yu la tshong khang dang / gnas pa po gang zhig ma 'dres pa so sor ston pa rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi dang / mgyogs por nyo ru 'gro dgos pas nga la bshad rogs gyis zhes la don ru sgra sbyar rkyen gyi nus pas nyo dgos pa'i dngos po gos chen dgos pa dang / bya ba bshad rogs gnyis ma 'dres par ston pa rnam dbye bzhi ba'i dgos ched dang / nga la bshad ces la sgra rkyen du ster ba'i nus pas bshad yul nga dang / bshad pa bya ba gnyis don ma 'dres par rnam dbye gnyis pa'i las su bya ba'o//rnam dbye de darga nor phyugs slas la 'khor ba bzhin so so gdang du 'khod pa bstar na/ rnam dbye dang po don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa dang / gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / gsum pa byed pa dang / bzhi ba dgos ched dang / lnga ba 'byung khungs dang / drug pa 'brel ba dang / bdun pa rganas gzhi dang /brgyad pa 'bod pa bcas 'di rnams ni bod kyi rnam dbye brgyad bya'o//gsum pa/ saṃ bod rnam dbye'i bar gyi 'brel ba bshad pa/de yang bod kyi rnam dbye ni legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye la khungs gtugs pa /87
yin pas/ de gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba cung che snyam/ sang yin zer na/ gtso bo legs sbyar la'ang rtsa ba'i rnam dbye grangs brgyad kyi sgo nas dbye yod phyir/bod la'ang de ba'in grangs brgyad kyis 'dus pas so/ /'di 'i slob dpon gyis skad gnyis la blo rig 'ib mo sa brtson pa'i nga' 6la gyi 'bras bu yin/legs sbyar ming gi mtha' can la rnam dbye li ster nas grub pa'i ngo bo tsam brjod pa 'di rngam dbye dang por byas pa la/ bod kyi ming yang de bzhin don gyi ngo bo tsam la 'gro bas rnam dbye dang por ba'ag de bzhin lesas sbyar ming gi mtha' can la rna ma dbye amra so gas byin nas grub pa'i yul la bya ba byed pa 'di gnyis pa la sa su bya bar brjod de/ bod la de lta bu'i skad 'a phrad la don du 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa las su bya bar brjod par ma zad/ lebs sbyar du nge sogs byin pa'i ched du dang / ji sorgas byin pa'i sanas pa'i rnam dbye de dag kyang / bod skad du phrad la can du 'gro bas / la don rnam dbye 'es brjod par bya ste/ lesas sbyar gyi rnam grangs bzhin bzhi ba dgos ched dang / bdun pa gnas gzhi 'es 'bod do/ /gzhan yang gsum pa byed pa dang / drug pa 'brel ba/ lnga ba 'byung khungs sogs kyang legs sbyar rnam dbye byin pa'i don la brtag pa dang / bod kyi skad la dmigs nas legs sbyar gsum pa byed pa ston pa la/ bod kyi dbang du phrad ris dang / drug pa 'brel ba ston pa la phrad gi sosas dang / lnga ba 'byung khungs ston pa la phrad nas las sbyar ba'i rnam dbye yin pas grangs kyi sgo nas kyang legs sbyar gyi rnam grangs ltar sbyar ba yin no//rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa yang legs sbyar dang rigs bsgres nas rnam 188
dbye brgyad kyi gras su bgrangs pa tsam ste bodal ni rnam dbye dang po ming tsam brjod pa nyid 'a sa/ zur du mtshan bzhi mi 'dra ba zhig ba'as tu med do/ /lebs sbyar gyi sgra gzhung du yang rnam dbye brgyad pa bod pa 'es pa'i tha snyad yod med brtag par bya dgos te/ thon mi'i 'al lung du bkod pa'i lo tsā ba chen po nam mkha' bzang po'i rgasu ngas las/ bdun po las ma gtorgas pa'i brgyad pa bod pa zhes tshad ldan gyi gzhung gang las kyang mi 'byung zhing / bod pa la'ang rnam dbye dang po'i si solas ster bar bathad pa'i phyir/ rnam dbye brgyad pa zhes zur du 'chad mi rigs so zhes gsungs so/ /'o na bod la rnam dbye brgyad pa zhes grangs su ston zhing / dper brjod kyang 'dog rgyu yo da pa rgyu mtshan du byas/ legs sbyar rnam dbye bdun pa'i phyis su kun tu 'bod pa'i don du te sngon du ba'as ces 'bod pa'i sgra can gyi rnam dbye zhig byung bas de la dbye ba'i phyir du brgyad pa thogs pa yin nam sems / brgyad pa 'bod pa zhes bod la kye dang kwa ye wa ye sogs thog mar bkod pa ni 'bod pa gsal ba mtshon pa'i ngon du bkod pa las 'bod pa'i yul la rnam dbye dang po nyid 'jus cing rnam dbye dngos ni min no/ /'di yang bod du ma zad/ legs sbyar gyi skabs su'ang /he zhes bod pa'i don mtshon byed du bkod pa yin gyi rnam dbye dngos ni si cha dzas zhes rnam dbye dang po'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /deng sang bod kyi brnga spyod 4 la las rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod sgra 'es rnam dbye dang po dang bsres nas grangs gcig i thos tu ba'ag nas gsung bzhin yod pa de'ang legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye rirgas bsres nas bshad pa yin pas/ don gyi thos nas 'asal ba ༷ 89
5rig pa sdang bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'ibar gyi 'brelaba'i skor bshad pa /med snyam/de'ang kun tu bod pa la si ti'o zhes dang po'i gcig chig si la rnyi zhes 'bod dgos pa ni rnam dbye dang po dang khyad par can te/ dbye dgos pa'i phyir du 'dod do//tshig gcig tu bsdus na/ legs sbyar dang bod bar gyi rnam dbye'i 'brel ba grangs kyi rnam ga'ag tsam las so so'i skad yin pa ni kun gyis nges dgos/'on kyang nye ba'i rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gis rnam dbye zhes sgra gzhung las drangs pa zhig yin zhes zer srog skad/ 'di ni mi 'grig pa zhig red/ gal te drangs pa yin na/ bod kyi rnam dbye dang po la si sogs dang / gnyis pa la amra sogs dang / gsum pa la 1 sogs dang / bzhi ba la nge sogs dang / lnga ba la ngasi sogs dang / drug pa la ngasra sogs dang / bdun pa la ji sogs kyi phrad yin dgos pa de dag sbyar yod dam/ 'o na bod kyi rnam dbye la ci'i phyir la don gyi phrad bdun dang byed pa'i phrad lnga/ 'brel ba'i phrad lnga/ 'byung ci khungs kyi phrad nas las/ tha na bod pa sogs tshig tha dad du gnas pa yin/gzhan yang / la las bod skad kyi sgra 'a tshig phrad tsam ston pas chog go rgya gzhung ltar rnam dbye zhes pa'i tha snyad dang dbye tshul dgos pa med zer ba 'di yang mi 'grig pa zhig red/ rang re bod kyi skad ni phun sum tshogs pa'i skad rigs shig yin pas/ de la don so sor ma 'dres pa'i rnam par dbye ba'i skad cha'ang de bzhin chags/ 'dir legs par brtag dgos na/ mang tshogs kyi skad rigs rmang gzhi'i thos legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye shesadagos pa ni gdong gi 190
nag rnag gsal bar me long tsam gyi phan yon che ba ji bzhin no/ /de yang gsal bor bshad na/ legs sbyar gyi gzhung gis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa la shan zhugs che bas/ de ni nyer dus mtsho bod mtho sgang gi rong bar rgya nag ta pe'i zhing las tshul du bcos mod/ 'on kyang zhing gru ba'i ma de dag la ta kre'i 'bru rigs de rigs yul gyi dbang sgas mi skye rung / rang gnas sa khul du legs par smin pa'i nas ni zhing sa de'i thog tu 'bras bu lcid kyis khur ba de bzhin no//bzhi ba/ saṃ bod rnam dbye'i bar gyi khyad chos bshad pa/spyir bod kyi brda sprod rig pa legs sbyar la sa khungs byas pa dang /dper brjod kyang 'jog mod/ 'on kyang de dag so so'i khyad chos ni mi 'dra sa che ste/ legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye tshe na/ rtags dang grangs ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med de/ ming tshig gang rung la rnam dbye ster ba'i skabs su/ thog mar skad dod kyi ming la pho mo ma ning gi rtags gang yin shes dgos pa ni cha rkyen dang po nang gi dang po yin/ de ma shes na rnam dbye'i rkyen ster thabs bral/de nas de shes kyang / grangs gang gi khongs su yin pa ma shes na'ang mi chog ste/rnam dbye la grangs rkyen gang ster dgos ma shes na rnam dbye sgrub thabs bral bas/ci nas kyang cha rkyen 'di gnyis ma shes na rnam dbye zer ba de shes mi thub/de'ang rtags kyi sgo nas ming la rag las pa dang / dus kyi sgo nas yi che rang la /9
ras las pa yin/ bod kyi rnam dbye la ming dang ming gi bar dang / tshig dang tshig gi bar bya ba dang bya ba'i bar/ ya nga na ming dang bya ba'i bar gang yin rung / rnam dbye phrad kyis ston nus te ming ngam tshig gi rjes 'jug yi ge la brten nas rnam dbye'i phrad sbyar dgos pa de bas chog nga tshos rtag par zer bzhin pa'i yi ge'i thob thang zer ba de gtso bo yin/ thog mar grangs kyi sgo nas che 'o nga tsam bstan te saṃ bod gnyis zar bdun re'am brgyad re yod zer mod/nang cases sogs kyi sgo nas zhib mor brtayos na 'di yang mi 'dra sa yod/legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye ni rnam dbye re re nang gses kyi sgo nas gcig tshig dang gnyis tshig mang tshig bcas bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig la 'khod pas bod la de ba'in sanyis tshis dang mang tshis sogs ni mi dgos par bor bas gcig tshig gi khongs rnams 'dod de rnam dbye bdun kho nar sbyar ba dang / ming sga ngo bo brjod pa thog nas bshad na legs sbyar gyi skabs su ming gang rung ska da dod la si sogs rnam dbye ster nas mdos sgrub pas / me tog me tog dag me tog rnams lta bu so so'i gzugs kyang tha dad du gyur pa'i ming gi rnam dbyer 'gyur bas / bod du me tog ces thad 7ra brjod pa'i ming gi ngo bor grub pas gcig tshig dang sanyis tshig mang tshigo sogs su dbye med cing / ming gcig la sgrub byed kyi 'gyur ba mang po'ang gtan nas 'byung mi srid/ de'ang bodal ming yi thog tu 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub sogs nang gses du ma chags pas/ming tsam ngos zin dgos pa ni ha cang dka' ba'i rigs su gyur to/ /de'i phyir bod kyi rnam dbye dang po'i ming dang rnam dbye so gas la gnyis tshig dang mang 92
tshis 'jug pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag de lta bu sbyar du mi rung ngo / /'dir dag ces pa'i sgra'ang spyir gnyis tshig kho nar 'jurga pa'i nges pa med de/ phal cher mang tshig la shas che zhing / gnyis kho nar 'jug pa'i phrad bod la med pas de'i don du gcig la mi 'jug cing gnyis yan la grangs nges meng du 'jug pa lo tsā ba rnams kyis spyi sgra'i bye bras sbyar nas sanyis tshigo tu sbyar ba yin no/ /des na darga ri sgra mang tshig la sbyor ba med ces smra ba ni legs sbyar gyi la da mo thal che ba'i gsung du snang ngo zhes sum rtags mgul rgyan du rgasungs so/ /la la sa thams cad dang / kun dang / mtha' dag sogs kyang rnam dbye'i mang tshig tu 'dod kyang 'di yang legs sbya ra gyi tshul ston pa las/ bod yig tu rnams zhes dang thams cad dang / kun dang mtha' dag dang sogs ni grangs kyi gnas mang tsam ston du phrad kyi tha snyad tsam las rnam dbye dngos ni mi 'dod snyam mo/ /de nas rnam dbye 'byed pa'i skabs su/ saṃ bod gnyis las legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye grangs mang yang dbye ba ni cung sla rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/legs sbyar rnam dbye re re la phal cher dngos thob kyi sgo nas si sogs byin nas sgrub phyir/ gang yin pa de ngos zin thub/ ming sga mtha' can sang rung la si byin nas grub pa de rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig dang / amra nges byin nas grub pa'i rnam dbye ni sanyis pa'i gcis tshig yin pa shes pa de ba'in yul gang la bya ba byed pa dang rgang las byung ba dang / gang gi yin pa dang / gang sis byed pa dang / gang la gnas pa sogs rnam dbye rkyen gyis mtshon thub par byed do/ /bod kyi rnam dbye sogs ni de 'dra min par la don gyi khongs su'ang rnam /93
dbye du ma phrad bcig gis ston nus pa ste/ yul la bya ba dang / dgos pa dang gnas pa sogs kyis mtshon dgos/ ga'an yang byed pa'i sgra gis sogs lnga bo dang / 'brel ba'i sgra gi sogs dang / 'byung khungs kyi nas la sa sogs phrad kyi nus pa che bas phal cher legs sbyar gyi chul du dbye thub/ dper na/ rta yis/rta yi/ rta la sa lta bu ston na/ 'di ni dang po des byed pa ston pa'i tshul dang /gnyis pa des 'brel ba'i dngos po thig ston grabs dang / gsum pa des gang gi de las cis kyang dngos po zhig 'byung rgyu sogs rganas thog gi rnam dbye rnams ngos zin thub/ gal te legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gocig tshig am byin pa dang / bzhi ba'i gcig tshig nge byin pa dang / bdu — pa'i gcig tshig ji byin pa sogs bod skad du byas na rta la/ rta la/ rta la 9) bur 'gyur bas rnam dbye ngos zin pa ni dka'o/ /de nas la don rnam dbye'i skor cung tsam brjod na/ de'ang legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye skabs su/ gnyis pa dang bzhi ba dang gnas gzhi sogs so sor rnam dbye'i rkyen mi 'dra ba re ster rgyu yod pas la don zhes bod yig lta bu'i phrad min pa kun gyis gsal lo/ /deng sang rgya nag gi rnam dbye la phrad re ldan par ma zad/ phrad gcig sgas rnam dbye du ma ston thub pa ni med/ spyir rgya nag gi yi ge ni spyi lo sngon dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i dus su byung yang / rnam dbye dar nas zhib 'jug gi bya ba'i lo rgyus ni lo ngo brgya tsam la slebs med/ gna' rabs yi ger rnam dbye med pa ni ma yin te/ gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi yi ge la 'pho 'gyur ches cher byung zhing / gna' rabs kyi yi ge la rnam dbye 194
dang phrad ni ha cang nyung / deng sang gi yi ger rnam dbye dang phrad ni rtswa thang du me tog bkra bzhin du yi ge'i khongs su khyab bo/ /bod kyi las su bya ba la5ṇ+ḍaririgragaji'iji sogs kyis don ston nus pa dang / dgos ched lta bu la66〉ri 7199sogs kyis ston nus pa dang / gnas gzhi lta bu la541 jitshoji47ri47 nyasogs kyis ston nus pas so// bod du rnam dbye de dag dang / yang na gnyis pa las su bya ba'i khongs su gtogs pa'i de nyid dang / gnas pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i tshe skabs bcas lnga bor phrad bcig yin phyir/ rnam dbye ngos 'dzin gyi thog tu rnyog 'dzing che ba'ang de rigs yin no/ /de'i phyir bod kyi rnam dbye la blo gros kyi rtse dang zhib cha'i so dang lngan pa'i sgo nas phrad byin pa'i snga gzhug gi don la zhib mor brtag dgos/ dper na/ rta la/ rta la/ rta la lta bu la don gyi rnam dbye yin pa phrad kyis ngos rin kyang / don ngo ma'i thog rnam dbye gang zhig gi rgyu mtshan ston pa gtan nas gsal mi thub/ gal te de dag gi rjes sor rim gyis sga gtod/ rna byin/ rngog ldan lta bu'i tshig sbyar na/ rta la sgo 4tod ces yul rta la bya ba sga gtod pas gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / rta la rtswa byin zhes gzhi rta der phan pa'i phyir du dgos pa rtswa byin pa dgos ched dang /rta la rngog ldan zhes canas gzhi rta la dngos po rngog ldan phyir bdun pa gnas bzhir gyur pas gzhi nas rnam dbye so so'i ngo bo gsal bor 'byed nus so/ /da lta bod kyi brda sprod rig pa las/ la don rnam dbye'i thad nas rnyog 'dzing cung ldan yang / don dngos thog nas ba da na 'di bod rang nyid kyi skad rigs brtag pa yin pa las/ legs sbyad gyi tshul bzhin ga la 'dod/ /95
slob dpon rin po che'i sku drin las so sor me long bzhin rtsa ba mdzad pa de las/gzhan du 'da' ga la dgos/yang na bod yig gi mchod pa brjod pa'i skabs kyi dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal zhes par 'grel mang che bas rnam dbye bzhi bar bshad pas/ 'di ni legs sbyar gyi tshul 'jog pa yin nam snyam/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ na mo buca ya(sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal)zhes sangs rgyas kyi skad dod buca zhes pa la rnam dbye bzhi ba'i gcig tshig nge byin/ nga yig 'gro ba'i khyad pa'i don/ nge la akra lhag ma byin/ kra gnas don/ e ayu/ 'dra ring / drangs pas buca ya zhes dgos pa'i ched du'i sgra sbyar/ de bzhin na mo rnyarmā ya(chos la phyag 'tshal)zhes pa dang / na mo sa ya(dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal)bcas la de bzhin bzhi ba dgos ched kyi gcig tshig nge byin nas bsgrubs pas grub/ spyir slob dpon gyi dgongs don la rnam dbye bzhi ba ni bya ba gang zhig gis bya ba'i don gyi yul de la phan gdags pa'i ched du 'jug pa de yin pas/ don 'di la gzhigs na/chos la phyag 'tshal lta bu ni yul khyad par can la phyag byed pa ni phyag byed pa po'i nyid dam de dang 'brel ba'i don las phyag yul de'i ched du min pa phyag gi yul la phyag byed pa po'i bya ba ston pas/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya bar 'jug na cung 'grig de'ang phyag byed pa ni yul sangs rgyas chos la phan pa'i ched du ma yin par phyag byed po rang nyid ngan song mi 'gro ba'i phyir du'o/ /gal te de bzhin yul gyi phan pa la ma bltas par bya ba'i don kho na'i phan pa la bsams nas bzhi bar 'jog na/ de ni gong gi thon mi'i dgongs pa dang mi /96
mthun par ma zad/ mi la rnyog 'dzing gi dpyang thag 'dren par byed/ shar phyogs su 'gro zhes pa ni da lta thun mong du bzhed pa'i gnyis pa las su bya ba'i dper brjod yin pas/ gal te gong gsal lta bur dbye na/ de'ang 'gro pa po rang nyid dgos pa zhig gi ched du shar phyogs la 'gro ba yin pas de'ang ba'i ba dgos ched la bzhag na 'grig gam/ de yin na bya ba tshang ma byed pa po rang nyid kyi phan pa dang / yang na sang zhig gi ched du ma bsgrubs pa ni gcig kyang med pas/ bod la rnam dbye bzhi ba las gnyis pa las su bya ba med na chog go'di lta bu'i dbye tshul ni mi dargyos dgos mdog ste mi shes pa rnams kyi mug ge thog gi zla lhasaltabu'i dper 'byung srid/ nga tshos cis kyang tshad ldan can gyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung la brten nas/ bzhi ba dgos ched lta bur byed pa po gang zhig gis bya ba'i yul de la phan 'dogs pa zhig yin na/ gzhi nas bzhi bar 'jug pa las/ byed pa po rang kho na'i phan par ma gzhigs na/ gnyis pa dang bzhi ba gnyis dbye ba'i thad la phan pa ci yod dam snyam/ de'ang la las chu la zam pa btsugs lta bu bzhi ba dgos ched du 'jog pas/ 'di yang zam pa btsugs pa ni bya ba byed pa po rang nyid kyi ched du las/ yul chu la phan pa med pas gnyis pa'i don la 'jug pa yin pa shes bzhin du/ yang na la las rta la rtswa byin lta bu gnyis par 'dod pa 'di yang / phar bltas na yul rta la bya ba rtswa byin pas tshad ldan gyi gnyis pa'i dpe la 'dra/ yin na'ang don dngos thog nas brjod na/ rtswa byin pa ni yu la rta'i ched dang / rtswa ni yang rta la dgos pa zhig yin phyir/ bzhi ba'i dpe brjod la khas ma len rang len du 'gyur ro/ /197
'di lta bu'i tshad gzhi gcig 'dzin na/ legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye gang byin pa de bod kyi rnam dbye de rang yin dgos pa'i nges pa med cing / bod rang nyid kyang rang nyid kyi rig par blos brtag mi thub pa 'byung ga la srid/gzhan yang sdig la 'jigs/ stag la skrag lta bu sogs bdun par mdzad pa dag legs sbyar gyi lugs su byas na/ 'byung khungs kyi tshul du yin pas/sdig las 'jigs/ stag las thog ces 'jigs dang skrag sogs ni 'dre sdig dang / gcan gzan stag sogs las 'byung ba'i phyir du'o/ /'di don gyi sgo nas bod dang brjod par 'gal ba med kyang / bod rang nyid kyi kha skad las 'di lta bu'i tshig mi yong bas/ sdig la 'jigs/ stag la skrag ces lta bus sdig dang stag ni 'jigs su rung ba'i dngos po yin skad/ 'jigs dang skrag sogs yul de la logs su gnas pas bdun pa nyid du sbyar ro/ /de'i phyir saṃ bod rnam dbye gnyis khungs gcig las drangs pa ma yin pa so so rang nyid kyi skad rigs khyad chos dmigs gsal du ldan pa de bzhin rna// zhes saṃ bod rnam dbye'i skor bshad pa'i sa bcad bzhi ba rdzogs so// 198
sa bcad lnga ba/ ṭ+wāṃ bod shā ཿ'irtabs ba dpasa bcad lnga ba/ saṃ bod yi sga'i rtags bshad pa/rang res rtasas kyi 'jug pa 'es brjod pa'i skabs su/ rtag par de la 'i se'i phro mo ma ning dang / des dus gsu ma gyi dbye ba/ bya byed las gsum gtsos 'dus pa 'i brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung 'u rgas la 'dod kyang / 'di'i ska bas su rtags 'es sto na pa ni pho mo ma ning gi rtags kho nar 'jug par yin no/ /dang po/ legs sbyar yi ge'i rtags bshad pa/de'ang legs sbyar gyi yi ge skabs su rtags la ming sga rtabs dang rnam dbye'i rtargas gnyis la 'jus pa bya ste /1 ming sga rtags bshad pa/spyir pho mo ma ning zhes sems can mtshan gyi rtags kho na la 'jug kyang /de'ang yi ge'am ming gi nang gses dang khyad chos/ rang bzhin bcas kyi ched du legs sbyar dang thog gi yi ge la 'di rigs sbyar ba 'dod pas / rigs de la bsgres nas 'dzam gling gi yig rigs mang tsam zhig la de'i shan shugs kyis pho mo ma ning gi sgo nas dbye srol mchis/ de'ang la la yi che'i 'bru la pho mo ma ning 199
sga dbye ba yo da pa dang / 'a la ra sgra sadangs mtho dman gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang /la la lnga/nga si sgo nas dbye srol bcas lda na/le cas sbyar lta ra na ming tshis re re bzhin tshang ma la rtags dang grangs kyi longs su 4to4sa/ de'ang rtasas zhis brjod pa 'di'ang brda sprod kyi rigs shis 'dod phyir ming sis ston pa'i dngos po dag ni rtags gang gi longs su btogs pa ra ston nus te/ dper na/ skyes pa la rtags pho dang / bud med la rtasas cho mtshan 4nyis sa ma ya nga na mtshan med pa ra ma ning 'bod pa sla yang / skad risas shis la mi/nga tshig khri khri 'bum 'bum yo da srid pas de dag ji lta ra dbye dbros zer na( spyir tshad ga'i nges can 'is med kyang / phal cher mi'am se ma gu can gyi rang bzhin lta ra dngos po'i ngo bo la brten nas btsun pa'am sod pa la pho'i rigs dang / dngos po'i skye rganas dang nyam khyon pa bcas la mo'i risas dang sto de sanyis kyi bar ma dang me da pa la ma smrung si rigs bcas ha la ma 'dod pa ra ma zad/ de'ang phor mtshon byed kyi ming gi sko ra dang 1 de'i yo byad dang de'i bya ba'am dngos po bcas pho'i ming si khongs su btogs nga dang : mo la 'ang de bzhin mos 'en pa 'i dngos po dang bya ba bcas 'jug pa ni mo 'i khongs su gtosas pa/ gnyis ka la 'jug pa nyid la ma ning la 'dod pa sa de'i mtshon byed du/ dper na/ sra zhing 'khregs pa'i mtshan nyid la dṛ ṣad 'es rdo yi ming ni pho ke 'jus pa dang / btsun 'ing lngid r+b+ya 'i skad la a dza nā 'es bka' yi ming ni pho la 'jus pa dang 'od zer tsha ba la lū ra tshes nyi ma'i ming ni pho dang / de'ang mdzes dang dri zhim gyi mtshan nyid 200
'a sa kā ra zhes me tog gi ming ni mo la 'jus pa dang / skye dngos kyi canas la bhū zhes sa gzhi ming yang mo la 'jug pa dang / 'od zer bsil ba la tsan+d+ra zhes zla ba'i ming mo la 'jug pa dang / ma ning gi sabs su nā ma 'es ming gi don dang / dza ga ti zhes 'dzam gling gi ming tshig sogs 'jog yod pa 'di dag sga thog nas bltas na/ pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba la chos nyid cung tsam lda na par snyam/de'ang klog pa po'i klad rgya cung zad rgya ru bskyed ched/ phro mo ma ning gi dper brjod kha shas bkod na/po'i skor la/ pu sa dha: pho'am mi'i don ya nga snang / pa — —— long pa/ a nu ḍā ta ge glang / sdu4 go dgra bo/ ma ru 1 — — rlung /ri wawa 'byor phyug 'di skabs 'gar ma ning la 'jug pi 4 pha'am khu bo/ sgyi 4 khyo ga'am bdag po/ a shwa wawa rta/ kha 'i snya na ngag pa/ pa sha wawab phyugs/ sa 'a grogs po/ pa tiḥ bdag po bcas so/ /mo'i skor la di tu go nam mkha'/ a pa wawa chu/ kāt+yāme tog phreng ba/ mā lnga : a ma/ ñcā ge bu mo'am bud med/ na rī go gtsang po/ — ——— blo'am sems/ ga4 4 4 bu mo'am na chung ma/ dhe nu 4 bzho ma/ rna: wawa gru/ bā tsa yi ge ngas la'ang zer nga tshos yi ge la gdangs zer ba ni 'di'i rgyu mtshan no/ /di shra wawa kha phyogs /dā k+ṣiḥ — — 3 mo/ gidra — skad cha/ na ra ma go dmyal khamathe bcas cas/ / 20/
ma ning si skor/ ha tra sa — — mchod rdzas/ nā ma 4wawa ming dzag 1 ——— 'dzam gling / ma nasra ba——— yid dang sems/ bā ri —— chu/ma 6 ge sbrang rtsi bcas so/ /gong dag gi dbye tshul yang gtan 'khol min pas/ la la rnam dbye'am rkyen ster ba'i skabs su gzhan la 'gyur tshul yod pa dang / la la gnyis la'i khongs su gtogs pa'ang yod/de'ang gas la dgos pa ni/ legs sbyar gyi phro mo ma ning gi rtags dbye chul ni ming gi thos kho na la rag ma las pa gtso bo rgya gar mi rigs rang gi sgyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang / bsam blo 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ mi rigs rang sga lugs sro' dang dngos po la ngos rin tshul / rang byung la brtse dung mtshon tshul bcas kyi sgo nas ming la rtags kyi dbye ba sbyar/ gal te gong gas la dag la cha rgyus zab mo med na/ ming gi dbye ba la dka' khag ha cang chen po 'byung srid/de'ang mngon gsal du mtshon thub pa ni/ sems can gyi rigs brjod pa'i ske bas su / phal cher spyi ming la pho'i rigs su gyur te/ dper na/ rta/ nor/mi sogs lta bu'o/ /de dag nang gses kyi sgo nas brjod pa'i tshe/ pho'i rigs la pho dang mo'i rigs la mo sbyar ba rigs pas nga tshos brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs sum rtabs brjod pa'i skabs su/ bdag sgra'i dbye ba bzhin du/ pa po sanyis 'jug yu la la pho dang / ma mo gnyis 'jug yul mo yin pas/ pu liṅga dang ñcā liṅga zhes brjod pa 'di'i don no/ /gzhan dag ming tshig gi dbye ba ni gtso bo mi rigs de'i ska da kyi nang don la cha rgyus dang rang gi yon tan che chung 202
la rag las snyam/ de'i phyir legs sbyar gyi yi ge ha cang rnyos 'dzing che bas/phyis su mi rnams kyis lag len byed mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gnad 'di la thug pa yin/de nas ming gang rung zhig la rtags gang zhig yin pa gsal rjes/ ga'i nas rtags la brten nas rnam dbye'i rkyen ster chog rtag par pho yig skabs su a thung yin pa dang mo yig skabs su rkyen lhab zhes ster ba ni mang / de'i phyir rnga bas sbyar kyi sabs su ming gi rtags dbye tshul ni gal che shos nang gi che shos yin/ gong gsal rnam dbye bshad pa'i le tshan nang du gzigs na cung zad gsal thub/2 rnam dbye'i rtags bshad pa/'di gong du bshad pa ltar ming la rtags dang ming la rnam dbye ster ba sogs mi 'dra ba gtso bo rnam dbye'i rkyen rang la pho mo ma ning li dbye ba phye yod pas de ru zer ba yin no/ /de'ang rnam dbye dang po don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i gnyis tshig au dang /mang tshig dzas/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i gnyis tshig au dang / ma nga tshig shadra bcas pho'i khongs su gtogs pa dang / de nas rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig si dang / gnyis pa las su bya ba'i gcig tshig amra dang / gsum nga/ byed pa'i gnyis tshig bh+yapra/ mang tshig 6sra/ bzhi ba dgos ched kyi gnyis tshig bh+yapra dang mang tshig bh+yas/ lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi gnyis tshig 6ma dang mang tshig bh+yas/ drug pa 'brel ba'i gnyis tshig o4 dang mang tshig ā.usto bdun pa 203
canas gzhi'i sanyis tshig yosra dang mang tshig supra sogs ni mo'i khongs su gtogs/ de nas rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig amra dang gnyis tshig rmuma nga tshig shas/ rnam dbye gsu ma pa byeng pa'i gcig tshig ṭā/ rnam dbye bzhi ba'i dgos ched kyi gcig tshig nge/ rnam dbye lnga ba'i 'byung khungs kyi gcig tshis ngasi/ rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba'i gcig tshig ngasra/ rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi'i gcig tshig ji bcas ma ning gi khongs su gtogs/ de dag cung sasal ba'i ched du re'u mig la bkod na/rnam dbye'i rtags kyi 'jus pa'i re'u miswawapo ༷༷ wa4wa wa wang ༷ ma ༷ ge ༷ wa / 4wa wa ste 204

rtags ni 'greng bu nyis brtsegs dang / na ro nyis brtsegs te/ i dang chalta bu'i ri mo 'di'o//lhag ma 'jig rten las sprub pa ni/ bsdu ba dang / cho ga'i rnam 'gyur/rkyen sogs skabs 'dir dngos su ma bshad pa'i lhag ma 'jig rten las grags pa yul gyi phal skad kyi rigs dang / bstan bcos rnams las brjod pa bde ba'i ched du lta bu grags shing / grub pa'i ming tshig brda chad rnams kyang gzhung 'dir kha skong si tshul du sbyor rung bas/ de dag las blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis po ni/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge bzhi dang mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge lnga bcas sde tshan gnyis po'i dbyangs dgu la thun mong du dbyangs zhes brdar btags pa de yin no/dbyangs kyi ye ge ni/ a i u ṛ '-i e o i charnams so/ /ṅgā mi'i yi ge ni/ dbyangs yig rnams kyi nang nas a yig ring thung darga yar bcad de/ bor ba'i lhag ma i man chad la/ nā min zhes brjod de/ i u ṛ ṛ e i o au rnams so/ /gsal byed kyi i ge ni/ ha ya wa ra la/ nya ṇa na ma nga / dzha rta dha gha bha/dza ṭa da ga ba/ kha pha tsha ṭha tha/ tsa ṭa 7 pa/ sha ṣa sa rnams so/ /de la ha sa zhes bsdus ming brjod/thog ma dang mtha' ma ni/ thog ma'i yi ge dang / tha ma'i yi ge brjod pas de gnyis kyi bar gyi yi ge rnams la go bar byed de/ dper na ha sa ces pa ha nas sa'i bar gyi yi ge dang / tsa pa zhes pa tsa nas pa'i bar gyi yi be rnams 22/
ngos bzung ba ste/ des dzha bha ces pa sogs gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o//dbyangs kyis dman pa ni/ yi ge'i srog la dbyangs med pa'i don gyis go bar byed de/ pha rol yi ge'i thog na drangs pa'am sbyar chog pa'i cho ga yod/bya ba'i ched du ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i ha la sogs pa'i gsal byed de dag gi srog tu gnas skabs/ a yig re bcug ste mitra'i ming can du byas te rkyen gzhan dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ dbyi bar bya ba de dag ni/ ngag tu brjod bde bar bya ba'i ched du yin te/ de med na brjod mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ /it+ya'i ming can ni/ kṛt+ya dang rnam dbye'i rkyen so rgas dngos ma yin pa peṃ das dang / rjes su 'brel ba'i yi ge gang zhig yod pa rnams la ni it+ya'i ming can zhis bya zhing / de das ni rkyen gzhan dang 'phrad ma thag tu yin 'dosas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi bya ba byung zin pas de'i khongs nas phral te dbyi dgos pa'i phyir na/ 'gro ba'i don can zhes bya la/ de min rjes 'brel dbyi ba sogs kyang 'gro ba'i don can te/ dper na/ ku dbyi ba la zhin dang / sgro ṇ+ṭha rjes 'brel dbyi ba 'gro ba'i don can la t+pa/ ces pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /ye ge mi mthong ba ni/ 'gro ba'i don can gyi byings rkyen rnam dbye rjes 'brel rnams dang / rnam bcad sogs gtan du phyis nas yi se'i gzugs mi mthong bar byas thing bsub pa la ni dbyi ba zhes bya ste/ ā las a ba la dbyi'o/ ༈zhes pas rnam bcad phyis pa lta bu dang / a i gnyis ka phyis nas e byas pa lta bu'ang ngo / /gzhan yang / mā sa'i a yang na dbyi ba'o/ /zhes pa sogs dbyi ba'i cho ga gang du byung ba'i skabs su dran par bya'o/ /222
dbyi ba ni/ skad dod la byings dang rkyen/ rnam dbye dang jes 'brel bcas sam ṭi thog na sgrub rin rjes mdzub mos phyi dgos pas de skad do /'gra ba ni/ dra sogs yi ge'i rjes 'brel rnams phyi dgos pa'i don kyang yin/ de'ang dbyi dang 'gro ba dang khyad don bcas sgra gzhung na phyi ba'i don yin no/ /b+thā ge 'gog pa rna/ 'di'ang dbyi'i don yin pas/ de'ang spyir rnam dbye sogs rkyen gyi yi ge 'ga' zhig la/ yi ge gzhan dang nor ba rnam par 'gog pa'i ched du sbyar ba rnams cho ga 'byung ba'i tshe/ dbyi ba de ni dbyi ba'i cho ga yin mod kyang / rkyen rang gi ngo bo'i cho ga dang byed pa rnams phyis nas 'byung ba'iphyir na dbyi ba tsam gyi ming du 'gyur te/ rjes 'brel phyis nas slar de'i cho ga rnams 'byung ba yin no/ /'dir lo pa zhes par/ gzhung ga'an du 'jig pa zhes bya ste/ rkyen gyi yi ge dbyi bar de'i rnam 'gyur rnams kyang med cing mi mthong ba/ de phan gyi at+ta 'jig pa'i tshe/ de'i rnam 'gyur 'phel ba'ang mi rtag pa lta bu dang / lo pashu ni gzhan du dbyi ba zhes yi ge de nyid dbyi zhing 'gog pa tsam las/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyi rnam 'gyur med par mi 'gyur ba dper na in+t+ra min pa la nyi 'jig kyang / de'i rnam 'gyur 'phel ba la sogs pa da dung gnas dgos pa lta bu dang / rnam dbye/ dzas/ shas/ nge so bas kyi dza dang / skyo dang / nga rnams phyis/ srog sga a bzhag pa lta bu'o//dgra dang 'dra ba ni/ 'di dpe ru 'jog pa ste/ yi ge bsgyur ba ni dgra jag gi spyod pa dang 'dra ba yi ge'i gzugs gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur ba bya ba 223
zhig ste/ dper na/ i lnga ru bsgyur ba lta bu pha rol gyi dbyangs dang 'brel ba can yin la/ ngas su ru bsgyur ba lta bu pha rol tu 'brel ba med kyang rtags mtha' la brten nas bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /gnyen dang 'dra ba ni/ de'ang dpe ru 'jog pa yin te/ rkyen gang zhig gnyan dang 'dra ba nam dgos pa'i tshe na/ phan 'dogs pa byed pa ni ltag ma lta bu'o/ /ā ga ma ni/ ā ga ma zhes pa lung ngam/ glo bur ba'i don yin/ ming dang / rkyen gyi bar dang / byings dang rkyen gyi bar du glo bur du 'jug pa'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir dang / rkyen des snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba dang / brjod pa bde ba sogs phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir na/ gnyen dang 'dra ba zhes brjod pa'o/ /'on kyang ā ga ma yin na bar rkyen kho na yin pas khyab pa med de/dper na/ nge la akra sbyor ba lta bu rkyen mthar 'jug pa'i ā ga ma dang / dim sogs la aṭa sbyor ba lta bu byings kyi thog mar sbyor ba'i ā ga ma yang yod pas de'ang nges dgos so/ /yang dag par smyor ba 'i/ dbyangs bar na med pa'i ha sa rnams yang dag par sbyor ba rnams so/ /'es dbyangs bar na med pa'i ha sa ste gsal byed srog med gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa brtsegs pa de la yang dag par sbyor ba 'es pa'i ming du brjod par bya'o/ /t+yā ba ni/ ku tsu ṭu tu pu sde ba rnams so/ /zhes u yig ni sde ba lnga bo rnams bzung ba'i don te/ ku zhes pas ka sde go ba lta bu sde ba rnams kyi dang po 224
rnams la u yig srog tu zhugs pas rang rang gi sde ba'i yi ge lnga pho rnams go bar bya ba'i don te/ ut+pa kyi sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /la lar ku so gas kyi u yig ni sngon gyi sgra shes rnams kyis brdar sbyar bar gsungs kyang /de ni sde ba la 'jug pa'i bsga'i thos mar saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas / /yan lag phyis nas kra srog med sogs drang ba'i phyir/ ka sde sogs go ba'i don yin gyi rgyu mtshan med par 'dod rgyal gyi brda chad sbyar ba bsam na mi rung ngo / /zhes mkhan po tshe rnam lags kyis gsungs so/ /yon tan rgya i ge ni/ rkyen gyi nus pa dang / byings rang ngos kyi yon tan las nā min gyi yi ge de dag gi yon tan yin pas de gsum la yon tan gyi yi ge zhes bya'o/ /'dir dngos su ma bstan kyang / lo'i añca du 'gyur ba'ang yod pas shugs 'a gu bo dgos so/ /'phel ba'i yi ge lha/ gtso bor/ ṇ+ḍat+pa sogs rkyen gyi nus pa la brten nas / a thung sga 'phel ba ā dang / ṛ yig si 'phel ba āru/ i yig gi 'phel ba i/ u yig sga 'phel ba charu bcas 'phel ba'i yi ge'i ming can bzhi 'es bya la/ 'phel ba'o zhes pa'i cho ga gang du byung tshe dran par bya'o/ /ni pā ta ni/ ā mtha' tshig phrad dang o mtha' ni pā ta ste/ nges tshig gi don dang / ha sa dang a sogs dbyangs gcig pa rnams la'ang mtshams sbyor thob pa ma yin te/ ā e waṃ ma n+ya se/ ā 'di skad sems no a tra grwa ta byaṃ/khyod 'dir gnas pa ra bya/ a e hi/ a tshur shog i in+d+ra pa sh+ya/ i dbang po la stos/ u utiṣ+ṭha/ u 'o ngas shig ces lta bu ste/ mdor na/ ni pā ta 'es 22 rta
pa ni tshig gi phrad la zer ro/ /ṭi zhes pa ni/ sgra mdo las/ mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa ṭi'o zhes dbyangs sam rkyen nam ming gi mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa'i khongs nas gsal byed srog med dang bcas pa'i yi ge de rnams la ṭi zhes pa'i brdar btags pa ste ṭi dbyi'o/ /zhes pa'i skabs su dran par bya'o/ /'di'ang dbyi ba'i don du 'dod pa dang dbyangs kyi don la'ang go'o/ /u pa dhā ni/ rtsa ba las mtha' las snga ma u pa ṅgā'o zhes gang zhig byings dang rkyen dang ming gi mtha'i gsal byed srog med kyi yi ge de kho na'i snga ma na yod pa'i dbyangs de la u pa dhā zhes ming du btags pa ste/ dper na/ rā dzan lta bu la dza'i srog gi a dang / mtha' rten dbyangs med na nu dang bcas pa la ṭi zhes btags shing / de las a yig ni mtha'i nu las sngon ma yin pa'i phyir u pa ṅgā'ang yin no/ /gzhan yang u pa rta'i yon tan zhes pa'i skabs su dran par bya'o/ /brtsegs pa ni/ yi ge'i srog la dbyangs med pas na/ pha rol gyi yi ge gang rung thog tu khang brtsegs bzhin brtsegs pa byed dgos pa de ru 'dod cing sbyor ba la'ang sga'o/ /yi ge smyu ba ni yang dag par sbyor ba'am brtsegs pa dang / rnam bcad dang / rjes su nga ro rnams pha rol na yod pa dang / ring po rnams ni ṭhā ba yin rna//yi ge yang ba ni/ pha rol tu brtsegs pa sogs pa'i thung ngu rnams ni 226
yang ba ste/ ldeb stor gzhung las/ brtsegs pa'i thog mar gang byung dang / /tsheg drag can dang thig le can/ /rkang mtha' ring po'i yi ge rnams/ /lci ba'i yi ge rnams su bshad/ /de las dzog pa yang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /pha rol ni/ 'di yi ge sgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pa yin te/ slob pa pos sam ṭi'i steng du sgrub pa'i skabs su/ de la 'bri sa phyogs gnyis tsam dbye bas/ 'bri ba po'i g.yon phyogs te skad dod sorgas la rkyen dang rnam dbye ster sa'i yul de yin no/ /tshu rol ni/ de bzhin 'bri pa po'i g.yas phyogs te skad dod sogs bzhag sa'i yul de ru ngos zin dbos so/ /rtags ni/ skabs 'dir pho mo ma ning gi rtags la zer ba min te/ yi ge'i tshu rol na skad dod sogs bzhag pa'i ming la zer/ rang re'i kha rgyun ltar rtags ri mo btab pa'i de'i rgyu mtshan no/ /tshig gro /sa rna de'ang skad dod sgrub byed kyi rkyen nam rnam dbye sogs tha rol na grol/sa kyi tshul du bzhag pa'i yi ge las/ tshig gi grogs dngos ni min/srog med ni/ yi ge gang rung gi khog na dbyangs zhugs med pa'i gnas skabs de'o/ /de'iskabs su yang dag par sbyar nas pha rol gyi yi ge la gcig brtsegs dang yang na gnyis brtsegs/ tha na de las mang ba brtsegs pa sogs yod do/ /ha lan ta'i mtshan:sna 'di ni hro tsa/ chad 3 tshan byed kyi rtasas kyi ming yin te/ de'i mtshon byed la/ dper na/ dra ṭu lha na mas/ tsakra lhab lta bu 227
'og tu ra btags 'dra zhing / yang ra btags las cung chung ba'i rtags kyi ri mo de la zer ro//rjes 'azel ni/ 'di rang re'i bod kyi yi ge rjes 'jug gi tshul du 'do da kyang / mi 'dra sa ni 'di tshang ma yi ge'i rkyen dang rnam dbye'i sogs rjes su zhugs pa'i srog med kyi yi ge de la zer/ de mang shos ni khyad don gyis dbyi bar bya'o/ /khud don ni/ 'di yi ge'i rkyen kyi rjes 'brel rnams khyad pa'i don gyis dbyi ba bya ba'i don te gang du bshad pa ltar/ dbyi ba dang 'gro ba/ 'gog pa dang / ṭi dang bcas rang re'i kha rgyun ltar na phyi ba dang bsub pa bcas kyi don dang gcig mthun yin pas/ khyad don zhes dbyi ba'i cho ga gang rung 'byung ba'i skabs su dran par bya'o//mtshams smyor lnga rna/ ming gi rab tu byed pa'i mtshams sbyor/ dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams sbyor/ gsal byed kyi mtshams sbyor/ rnam par bcad bya'i mtshams sbyor te lnga'o//gnyis pa/ rnam dbye'i ming bshad pa/ming gi rnam dbye la si sogs ni/ skyes pa'i rtags dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang / bud med kyi rta4sa dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang / ma ning gi rtags dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang / ha sa'i mtha' las skyes pa'i rtags dang ha 228
sa'i mtha' las bud med kyi rtags dang / ha sa'i mtha' la sa ma ning gi rtags dang / yumadu asmad kyi cho ga dang / mi zadaspru'i sde dang / dud med kyi rkyen dang / byed pa can gyi rab tu byed pa dang / tshig sdud kyi rab tu byed pa dang /de phan gyi rab tu bya ba rnams so/ /1 skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' can dang de bzhin du/ ā ring / u thung / i thung / ī ring / u ring / ṛ/ i/ cu/ 'jiyig mtha' can no/ /2 bud med kyi rtags a thung ra tha' can dang / de bzhin du/ ā ring /i thung / ī ring / u thung / ྅ ring / ṛ/ i/ gun tshegayig mtha' can rnazubs cas/ /3 ma ning gi rtags a thung mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ e thung /ī ring / ā ring / u thung / ḍā lha ring / ṛ yig mtha' can rnams so/ /4 3 yig mtha' can bar / de bzhin du/ dra/ nu/ za/ rnya/ dz+ra/dz+dza/ shu/ ṣ+pe/ badz+ra/ padz+ra/ = dz+ra/ bhadz+dza/ dra/ bra/ dz+dza/ tro/ sra yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du bsgrub pa'i tro mtha' u yig rjes 'brel can dang / tro mtha' ṛ yig rjes 'brel can sogs shin tu mang ngo / /5 hwa yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ bu/ dra/ rnya/ bha/ dra/za/ tro/ ṣ+pe/ pra yig mtha' can rnams so/ /6 6 yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ nu dra za dz+dza tro khu sra yig mtha' can rnas so/ /rnam dbye 'jug tshul ñcha dbye ba ni/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs su/229
gcig tshig la si/ gnyis tshig la chadang / mang 6ga la dzas ster ba'o/ /de bzhin du/ rnam dbye gnyis par/ ardza/ ma sra/ rnam dbye gsum par/ṭā/ :ma/ )sra/ rnam dbye bzhi ba la nge / 6za/ 6sra/ lnga ba la ngasi lcam/6sra/ rnam dbye drug par/ ngasra osu/ lham/ rnam dbye bdun par/ ji/og/ subra byin nas bsgrub tshul rnams so//dbyings las tshim ngu brgyab pa'i kun bshad kyi rab byed ni/ byed pa po'i rab tu byed pa dang / dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa/ lkog gyur gyi rab tu byed pa dang / smon par byed pa'i rkyen dang / de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur don gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / byung zin gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa dang / yadra 'jig pa'i mtha'i rab tu byed pa dang / rkyen dang stor ba'i rab tu byed pa dang /kun nas sbyor ba'i rab tu byed pa dang / kun nas bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa rnams dang / kṛt+ya la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o//1 da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ )spru/ tagra/ zha arnyi/ sipa/ thasra/ tha/mispru/ bsra/ masra/ te/ 〉te/ a na te/ se/ mthe/twe / e/ ba he/ ma he rnams so/ /'jug bzhin pa dang bya ba shes par nus pa'i da ltar ba'i don la rnam dbye tipra la sogs pa 'di rnams 'jug go /cho ga 'byung ba'i gnas dag la 'jug pa ni/ āt+pa/ ya 5za/ lusra/ lngas/ yī te/ lhatwa/ ṇ+ḍa/ yā ba/yā mā/ lhasata/ khri'i tsā/ ī ran/ lhagathasra/ ī yā ṭ+wāṃ/ 4lha/ lhagag rdzib 230
hi/ rim hi/ rnams so/ /cho ga zhes bya ba'i don la nye bar ston pa dang 'byung ba'i gnas te rtogs pas shes pa'i bya ba'i don la rnam dbye āt+pa la sogs pa 'di rnams 'jug par byed do/2 shis byed dang byed du 'jug pa dag la 'jug pa ni/ tuspru/ ṭ+wāṃ/ar+sha/ hi/ taṃ/ ta/ lha'ispru/ a baspru/ lhamabra/ ṭ+wāṃ/ utsā/ asgyuza swa/ a+thi+-ithā/ snyam/ im/ ltab)bra/ ltam he rnams so/ /ma thob pa thob par byed pa sogs bkra shis pa'i don dang / 'dod pa dang mthun par bskul ba sogs byed du 'jug pa'i don la tuspru la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /3 de ring ma yin pa'i 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dipya/ tam/ an/sib/ tam/ tro/ a mispru/ ba/ ma/ tan/ ā tā mra/ an+ta/ thāsra/ ā thām/dha/ i/ ba hi/ ma hi rnams so/ /de ring ma yin pa'i 'das pa ste dus 'das pa yin pa la 'das nas yu na ring ma song ba'i don / dipya la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug go /4 dngos po dang las kyi don la 'jug pa ni/ byings las med la dngos po'i don du rnam dbye ātā ne pa da rnams 'jug cing / de yang nyer bsgyur gyi stobs kyis bsgyur ba la ma nges pa sogs khyad par 'ga' 'ig ma gtogs/ ming gi rnam grangs logs pa med do//5 lkog tu gyur pa'i don la 'jug pa ni/ khoblo/ a tus/ usra/ tham/a thug sa/ gapra/ ba/ ma/ e/ ā te/ e re/ se/ ī the/ dhe/ e/ ba 23/
he/ ma ye rnams so/ byings las lkog tu gyur pa'i dus brjod pa'i byed pa'i don 79spru 'a sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug zhing / lkog tu gyur pa'i dus de la'ang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis su yod pa las 'das pa la 'jug par ma zad/ 'das pa de yang 'das nas dus yun ring lon pa'i dus la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /6 smon par byed pa'i don gyi bya ba brjod pa la 'jus pa ni/ āt+pa/yā / yā supra/ 'isra/ ā / yā sta/ yā swa / lhusma/ duṣ+ṭa sī/ yā / sī ran/sī 4sra/ si yā sgri/ r+sā4/ r+sāya/ smi ba hi/ sī ma hi rnams so// smo na par byed pa'i don gyi bya ba brjod pa la āt+pa la so gas pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug go /7 de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don la 'jug pa ni/ tā( tā ro/tā rasra/ tā si/ tākhrisra/ tā lū/ zlasmi/ tā4sra/ tā sma sra / tā/ tā ro/ tā rasu/ tā se/ tā ṭ+wā the/ tā lha/ tā he/ 7sba he/ 〉smatswa rnams so/ /de ring ma yin pa 'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don la tā la so gas pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug la/ 'byung 'gyur de yang dus ring po ma yin pa'i nye bar 'byung ba la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /8 'byung 'gyur dus ring po'i don la 'jug pa ni/ rnam dbye dipya la sogs pa bco brgyad po la subra bar rkyen du 'gyur ba 'di rnams 'jug la/ de yang ma 'ongs pa dus ring po la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /9 bya ba shor ba'am mi 'dzom pa'i don la 'jug pa ni/ rnam dbye dipa 232
la sogs pa'i bco brgyad po la supra byin pa 'di rnams 'jug ste/ de yang bya ba shor ba ste dus la ma 'khol ba'am rgyu tshogs ma 'dzoms pa dang / bya ba ma rdzogs par 'phro lus pa dang / bya ba zin ma thag pa'i grub zin gsar be rnams kyi don la 'jug pa shas che'o//10 byung rin tsam gyi don brjod pa la 'jug pa ni/ rnam dbye dipya la sogs pa bco brgyad po la bar rkyen si byin pa 'di rnams 'jug ste de yang dus 'das nas yun ring song ba la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /rnam dbye 'di rnams kyi ming 'dogs tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni dbyangs can ga ka ra ṇa'i lugs la/ kun bshad kyi rnam dbye tipra sogs brgya dang brgyad cu po la sde tshan bcu ru yod la/ sde tshan re re la'ang dgu tshan gnyis gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po dgu ni pa ras pa da ste gzhan don gyi tshig can gyi rnam dbye dang / phyi ma dgu ni/at+pa ne pa da ste bdag don gyi tshig can gyi rnam dbye zhes tha snyad btags so/ :pā ṇi pa'i lugs la/ 6spru sogs kyi rnam dbye sde tshan bcu'i dang po la/ laṭa zhes pa dang / gnyis pa la/ lidu zhes pa dang / gsum pa la loṭa zhes pa dang /bzhi ba ladra zhes pa dang / lnga pa la lidu zhes pa dang / drug pa la smon pa'i lidu zhes pa dang / bdun pa la luṭa zhes pa dang / brgyad pa la liṭa zhes pa dang /dgu pa la ladra zhes tha snyad btags so/ /233
gsum pa/ sgra gzhung brjod bya'i ming ston pa/rang bzhin ni/ byings dang ming gnyis yin la/ de'ang thog ma'i rang bzhin byings yin zhing / de la bya ba'i don zhes kyang bya'o/ rang bzhin gnyis pa ming ngam rtags ni/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum gang rung can dang /dbyangs sam gsal byed srog med gang rung gi mtha' can yin rna/ /rkyen rna/ byings la sbyar nas ming sgrub pa kritra rkyen yin te/ byings 'ga' zhig dang / ming 'ga' zhig dag la ji ltar rigs par sbyar bas byings su 'gyur ba'i rkyen san rnams kyang yod do/ /rnam 'gyur rna/ rang bzhin dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur ba a yig sgra ldan la ring po 'gyur ba lta bu dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dbye ba rtags mtha'i na yig lta bu dang / rkyen dang rjes 'brel bsgyur ba ṭā i na ru bsgyur ba lta bu dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dbyi ba a yig mo rtags can la si dbyi ba lta bu dang / yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur ba dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshams sbyor ba lta bu dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dbyi ba la/ tshig mthar en+t+ra otra las pha rol gyi a yig dbyi ba lta bu rnams rnam 'gyur yin no/ /234
bzhi ba/ rnam dbye'i yan lag 'jug tshul skor gyi ming ston pa/64dra dang amadra ni/ 'di la 'gyur ba'i cho ga yod de/ mdo las si yis rtu arnya'o zhes yu3dra amadra dag ni rnam dbye dang po'i si pha rol la byung na/ rtags dang rnam dbye lhan cig rim pa bzhin ṭ+wāṃ dang a haṃ zhes par 'gyur te/ yu3dra si dang bcas pa ṭ+wāṃ dang / asmad si dang bcas pa a haṃ du bsgyur pas/ ṭ+wāṃ ni khyod ces pa'i don dang / a haṃ ni nga'am bdag ces pa'i don rna/ /de nas 'gyur ba de bzhin rnam dbye rnams sgrub pa'i cho ga yod do/ /ñcha zad pa'i t+yā ni/ 'di ni rtags gsum dbye ba med par 'jug pas/pha rol gyi rnam dbye thams cad 'jig cing / rang nyid gzugs gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i sde tshan te/ de la tsa sogs rang bzhin gyi mi zad pa dang / tat+pa sogs rnam dbye'i don gyis bcos pa'i mi zad pa dang / dmigs bsal nye bsgyur sogs don tshan gsum gyi sgo nas dbye yod do/ /tsheg brtsa ba ni/ byings dang rnam dbye rang rkyang pa don ston mi nus pa lta bu ma yin par/ don dang ldan pa'i rnam dbyes khyad par du byas pa'am/rnam dbye sogs rab tu bkram pa'i tshig gi stor ba rnams nyung ngur bsdus te brjod pa rna tshig sdud ces bya la/ tshig snga phyi bar gyi rnam dbye dang phrad rnams 235
bsdus nas/ ming lnga phyi lhan cig tu sbyor bar byed pa'i ngag de rna tshig sdud kyi ngo bo yin la/ don 'gal ba ma yin pa'i ming tshig tu grub pa gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa bsgrigs pa'i phrad dang / rnam dbye sogs mang por bkram pa'i sbyor ba rnams la bsdu ba thob pa la de dag gcig tu bsdus pas/ tshig phan tshun ma 'brel ba rnams gcig tu 'brel zhing / tshig spyor ba/ tshig zor yang ba 'gyur ba ni tshig sdud kyi dgos pa yin rna/ /de la mi zad pa'i bsdu ba dang /de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba dang / bzlas dbye'i bsdu ba/ phyogs gnyis pa'i bsdu ba/'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba bcas don drug gi sgo nas dbye yod/de phan ni/ ming las ming du sgrub pa'i de phan gyi go don yin pas de la rkyen rnam dbyer gyur pa'i rkyen dang / ma gyur pa'i rkyen gnyis yod de/ si sogs nyer gcig dang / ti sogs brgya dang brgyad cu ni/ de phan gyi rkyen du gyur pa'i rnam dbye rnams yin la/ de'ang rnam dbye min pa'i de phan yang yod la sgra mdo sogs su gsal lo/ /lnga ba/ yi ge'i khams bshad pa/b+thā ge'i khams ni/ de ni yi ge la sbyar ba'i 'byung ba lnga'i khams bshad pa yin te/ nam mkha'i khams dang / rlung gi khams/ me yi khams/ chu yi khams sa yi khams bcas so/ /de la'ang 'byung ba che chung gnyis kyi sgo nas 236
bshad yod pas/ thog mar 'byung ba che ba'i lugs la/1 nam mkha'i 965sa ni/ rtsa ba las/ a ku ha ṅka nam mkha'i khams//mgrin pa'i gnas las skye ba yin/ /zhes pa de yang a ku zhes pas dbyangs kyi a lhagaganyis mtshon la/ ku zhes pas ka kha ga gha nga mtshon te/ tsan+d+ra pa las/ u ta'i sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas ka sde mtshon la/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams kyang 'dis mtshon nas shes par bya'o/ /des na sngar bstan pa'i a ñcāgnyis/ ka kha ga gha nga dang / ha dang ṅka ste dgu po 'di rnams ni nam mkha'i khams yin la/ skyetshul mgrin pa'i gnas las skye ba yin te/ de yang nam mkha' la reg bya'i thogs pa dang bral ba ltar/ lce gang la'ang ma reg par skad kyi gdangs sangs sangs su mgrin pa'i gnas las 'byung ba'o/ /spang bya zhe sdang gi gnyen po byed la/ mthar thug me long lta bu'i ye shes skye ba'i rgyu byed do/ /2 rlung gi khams ni/ rtsa ba las/ i tsu ya sha rlung gi khams/ /lce rtse so rkan dag las skye /zhes pa de bzhin du is mtshon pa'i gi'idang / tsus mtshon pa'i tsa tsha dza dzha nya dang / ya dang sha ste dgu po 'di rlung gi khams yin la/skye chul lce rtse so dang rkan rnams sbyar ba dag las skye zhing / lce yang g.yo ba'i tshul las 'byung ba yin te/ rlung ni yang zhing g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can yin pas so/ /spang bya nga rgyal gyi gnyen po byed la/ mthar thug mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyu byed do//3 me yi khams ni/ rtsa ba las/ ṛ ṭu ra k+ṣa me yi khams/ /spyi bo dag 237
las skye ba yin/ /zhes ṛ ṭu ni ris 2 rī dang / kyus ṭa ṭhi ḍa lha ṇa dang / ra dang khu ste dgu ni me'i khams yin la/ skye tshul lce rtse steng du bkug ste rkan gyi mthar sbyar ba'i spubs kyis spyi bo dag las stongs stongs su skye ba yin te/ me gyen du 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas so/ /spang bya gti mug 'joms/chos dbyings ye shes skye ba'i rgyu byed do/ /4 chu yi khams ni/ rtsa ba las/ u pu wa po chu yi khams/ /mchu yi gnas las skye ba yin// zhes u pu zhes pa'i khus u u dang / pus pa pha ba bha ma dang / wa dang pa ste dgu po 'di chu'i khams yin la/ skyetshul mchu gnyis sbyar ba'i gnas rlung shugs thur du 'byung ba las skye ba yin te/ chu ni thur du 'bab pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas so/ /spang bya phrag dog 'joms/ bya sgrub ye shes skye ba'i rgyu byed do/ /5 sa yi khams ni/ rtsa ba las/ '-i tu la sa sa yi khams/ /lce rtse so las skye ba yin/ /zhes '-i tu zhes pa'i zlas '-i lī dang / tus ta tha da rnya na dang /la dang sa ste dgu ni sa'i khams yin la/ skye tshul lce rtse so las skye zhing lce 'thas 'thas po'i tshul du 'byung ba yin te/ sa'i rang bzhin sra zhing 'thas pa yin pas so/ /spang bya 'dod chags kyi gnyen po byed la/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba'i rgyu byed do/ /dbyangs e i gnyis ni i zhiganyis dang khams mthun la/o shākhriganyis ni u u gnyis dang khams mthun pa'o//de nas 'byung ba chung ba'i lugs ni/ 'byung ba chung ba sde lnga yi/ /ka tsa 238
ṭa ta pa rnams sa/ /kha sogs chu yin ga sogs me/ /snya sogs rlung yin nga sogs mkha'/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de la 'byung ba chung ba ni/ sde lnga yi dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams sa'i yi ge yin la/ gnyis pa kha dang sogs pas kha tsha ṭha tha pha rnams chu'i yi ge dang / gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba rnams me'i yi ge dang /bzhi pa lha dzha n+ta rta rta rnams rlung gi yi ge lnga pa nga nya ṇa na ma rnams ni nam mkha'i khams kyi yi ge yin rna/ /des na 'byung ba che chung gi khyad par ni/'byung ba che ba rna dbyangs gsal thams cad la baji bas che ba yin la/ chung ba ni g+ne lnga kho na baji zhing gzhan la mi baji bas chung ba'o/ /'byung ba che chung gi khyad par re'u mig(wa)wa(ba wa/ wawa pha ba nga sa nanas||༷ 239
khams kyi dgra grogs ni/ 'di 'byung dngos phrad mi phrad bzhin yi ge la'ang de bzhin 'dod pa'o/ /1 dgra grogs baji gzhi ni/ yodang na mo tabyathā/ /spangs pa'i sngags kyi thog ma dang / /rang gi ming thog gzung bar bya/ /gsal byed brtsegs sam 'phul bzhag yod/ dang po'iyi ge gzung bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de yang bsgrub bya yi dam lha'i snying po'i ma(bkra shis pa dang g.yang)dang na mo(phyag 'tshal lo)dang / tabya:('di lta ste)dang / sabya the dan('di ji lta bar 'gyur ro)sogs spangs pa'isngags kyi thog ma oṃ a ra pa tsa na lhaḥ('gro ba smin par byed pa'i blo can rna) lta bu'i 5dor ba'i a nyid baji ba dang / bsgrub bya'am sgrub pa po rang gi ming gi thog ma gzung bar bya ba yin te/ 'phul brtsegs med pa'i rkyang par byung na thog ma'i yi ge gang yin gzung bar bya ba yin la/ de yang rang gi ming gi thog ma ni/ blo bzang lta bu gsal byed brtsegs pa yod dam/bstan rgyas lta bu 'phul bzhag yod pa byung na dang po'i yi ge la btags kyi ba dang sngon 'jug gi ba gnyis bzung bar bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan rnams ni ma yin 240
rna/ /2 dgra grogs kyi 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ gsal byed dgrar gyur nad mang zhing / /dbyangs yig dgrar gyur srog dang bral/ /tha mal gyur na 'bras bu med/ /grogs su gyur na dngos grub 'byung / /de phyir dgra grogs baji ba gces/ /zhes pas bstan te/ yi dam lha'i snying po'i thog ma gsal byed yin de rang gi ming gi thog ma'i dgra ru gyur na lus la nad mang du 'byung zhing sdug bsngal bar 'gyur te/(1)sa yig ni/ de yang gsal byed sa yig yin pa dgra ru gyur na nang bad dzin dang sa nad la brten pa'i rigs 'byung ba shas che la/ phyi rol tu yang khang pa zhig pa dang / sa 'og tu lhung nas na ba sogs 'byung ngo / /(2) chu yig ni/ gsal byed chu yig yin pa dgra ru gyur na nang chu nad dang grang ba shas cher 'byung la/ phyi rol tu phyugs la sogs yod na/ chus 'khyer ba dang zhing sogs la shwa 'od sogs 'byung ba'i skyon yong ngo / /(3) me yig ni/ gsal byed me yig yin pa dgra ru gyur na/ nang mkhris pa dang rims sogs tsha nad drag po 'byung la/ phyi rol tu khang pa dang rtswa shing sogs la me'i gnod pa 'byung ngo / /(4) rlung yig ni/ gsal byed rlung yig yin pa dgra ru gyur na/ nang rlung la brten pa'i nad 'byung la/ phyi rol tu khang zhing sogs la rlung gi gnod pa 'byung ngo / /(5) nam mkha'i yig ge ni/ nam mkha' la dgra ru gyur pa mi srid do/ / 24
(6) dbyangs yig ni/ dbyangs yig dgra ru gyur na srog dang 'bral ba'i nyes pa 'byung /(7) gsal byed ni/ gsal byed dgra ru gyur na lus la gnod pa 'byung bas so/ /nad 'byung tshul ni gong gi rigs bsgres pas shes so/ /'dir 'ga' zhig gis dbyangs gsal byed kyi dgra ru mi 'gyur te/thabs shes yin pas so/ /zhes smra ba ni mi 'thad do/ /dgra grogs gang yang ma yin par tha mal du 'gyur na/ dgos don gang la yang 'bras bu med pas mi 'grub bo/ /grogs su gyur na ni gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung ste/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dgra grogs baji ba'i tshul ni/ shin tu nas kyang gces pas brtsi bar bya'o/ /de la sde lnga la 'byung ba che chung gnyis las chung ba dbang btsan pas chung ba baji bar bya'o/ /lda dgra grogs kyi ngo bo ni/ ngos bzung ba la nang gses gsum dbye yod pa las/(1) dgra yin tshul bshad pa ni/ sa dgra me yin me dgra chu/ /chu dgra rlung yin rlung dgra sa/ /zhes pas bstan te/91) sa yig gi dgra ni/ sa yig rnams kyi dgra ni me yig rnams yin te/dper na/ sa yig ka tsa ṭa ta pa la sa rnams dang de'i dgra bo mo yig ga dzo ḍa da ba ra ṣa bcas yin pas mes sa tshig par byed pas so/ /(21 me yig gi dgra ni/ me yig rnams kyi dgra ni chu yig rnams yin te/me yig ga dza ḍa da ba ra khu rnams dang / de'i dgra bo chu yis kha tsha ṭha tha pha wa po 242
bcas yin pas chus me gsod par byed pas so/ /2) chu yig gi dgra ni/ chu yig rnams kyi dgra rna rlung yig rnams yin te/chu yig kha tsha ṭha tha pa wa tha rnams dang / de'i dgra bo rlung yig snya dzha ho rnya bha ya sha bcas yin pas rlung gis chu skoms par byed pas so/ /947 rlung yig gi dgra ni/ rlung yig rnams kyi dgra ni sa yig rnams yin te/rlung yig gha dzha 3 dha rta ya sha rnams dang / dgra bo sa yig ni ka tsa ṭa ta pa la sa bcas yin pas sas rlung 'gog par byed pas so/ /gal te dgra gyur kyang yi dam lha de snying la bcangs nas bsgrub par 'dod na/ 'byung bzhi'i sa bon dang snying po'i thog ma sbyar ba'i bzlas pa byed lugs yod de/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /(2) phan tshun nus med du 'gyur tshul ni/ sa ni me la nus pa med/ /me ni chu la nus pa med/ /chu ni rlung la nus pa med/ /rlung ni sa la nus pa med/ /zhes pas bstan te/ sa yig rnams me yig rnams la nus pa med pa yin la/ de bzhin du me yig rnams chu yig rnams la nus pa med pa yin no/ /gzhan yang /chu yig rnams rlung yig rnams la nus pa med pa yin la/ de bzhin du rlung yig rnams sa yig rnams la nus pa med pa yin te/ de rnams kyi nus pa bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /(3) grogs su 'gyur ba'i tshul bshad pa ni/ sa chu phan tshun grogs po ste//me rlung phan tshun grogs po yin/ /nam mkha' kun gyi grogs yin te/ /kun kyang nam mkha'i grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan te/ sa yig rnams dang chu yig 243
rnams phan tshun grogs po yin te/ 'jig rten na'ang sas chu 'dzin par byed pas so/ /de bzhin du me yig rnams dang rlung yig rnams phan tshun grogs po yin te/ rlung gis me sgar bas so/ /nam mkha'i yi ge rnams ni 'byung ba bzhi'i yi ge kun kyang nam mkha'i yi ge'i grogs su 'gyur ba yin te/ nam mkhas 'byung ba bzhi po gang la'ang gegs mi byed par rten byed pas so/ /gzhan yang / 'byung ba phan tshun nang phrad na grogs su 'gyur ba yin te/'jig rten na'ang chu dang chu phrad pas chu cher 'phel ba'i nus pa dang ldan pas so/ /de bzhin sa yig dang sa yig phrad pa/ me yig dang me yig phrad pa/ rlung yig dang rlung yig phrad pa ji bzhin du/ rgya gar gyi yi ge de rnams khams de ltar yin pas dgra grogs kyang de ltar yin rna/ /bod kyi yi ge ca cha ja dang /zha za 'a rnams khams gang gis bsdus she na/ ca cha ja gsum tsa tsha dza yi khams/zha za 'a gsum nam mkha'i khams yin rna/ /zhes bshad pa 'di las shes dgos te/ sgra'i bstan bcos las ming gi brda dgrol ba bshad pa'i sa bcad drug pa rdzogs so/ /smras pa/dbyangs gsal kun tu bkra ba'i me tog gis/ /phyogs rnams rab tu myos pa'i dri bsung khyab/ /kho bo blo yi 'dab ma sngon po yis/ /kha ba'i lngongs 'dir brgyan pa ci'i phyir 'phangs / 244
